test.title: Bringing a bog back to life

paragraphs.text: Peat bogs cover only a small part of the Earth’s land surface, but they store more carbon than all the world’s forests combined. They form over thousands of years as dead plants build up in waterlogged ground, where there is too little oxygen for them to decay completely.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: In the past, many bogs were drained so that the land could be used for farming or so that peat could be cut and burned as fuel. Once a bog dries out, the stored carbon begins to escape into the atmosphere.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Restoration usually starts with blocking the drainage ditches using small dams made of peat or wood. As the water level rises, mosses return, and over time they begin to form new peat. On one restored site, the water table rose by 30 centimetres within two years.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Progress is slow, and results depend on the weather. A dry summer can undo much of the work, which is why restoration teams monitor water levels throughout the year and repair dams after heavy storms.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: Bringing a bog back to life

items.quote: they store more carbon than all the world’s forests combined
items.prompt: Peat bogs store more carbon than all the world’s 1 ____.

explanation.en: “more carbon than all the world’s forests combined” → forests. “Combined” is not needed: the meaning is complete.
explanation.kk: «more carbon than all the world’s forests combined» → forests. «Combined» артық: мағына толық.
explanation.ru: «more carbon than all the world’s forests combined» → forests. «Combined» лишнее: смысл уже полный.

items.quote: where there is too little oxygen for them to decay completely
items.prompt: Dead plants in bogs do not decay completely because there is too little 2 ____.

explanation.en: Plants do not fully decay because there is “too little oxygen for them to decay completely”. The answer oxygen comes right after “too little”.
explanation.kk: Өсімдіктер толық ыдырамайды, себебі онда «too little oxygen for them to decay completely». Oxygen жауабы мәтінде «too little» сөзінен кейін бірден тұр.
explanation.ru: Растения не разлагаются полностью, потому что там «too little oxygen for them to decay completely». Ответ oxygen стоит в тексте сразу после «too little».

items.quote: so that peat could be cut and burned as fuel
items.prompt: Some bogs were drained so that peat could be burned as 3 ____.

explanation.en: “peat could be cut and burned as fuel” → fuel. “Farming” is the other reason for drainage in the same sentence.
explanation.kk: «peat could be cut and burned as fuel» → fuel. «Farming» — сол сөйлемдегі құрғатудың басқа себебі.
explanation.ru: «peat could be cut and burned as fuel» → fuel. «Farming» — другая причина осушения из того же предложения.

items.quote: blocking the drainage ditches using small dams made of peat or wood
items.prompt: Restoration begins by blocking drainage ditches with small 4 ____.

explanation.en: “using small dams made of peat or wood” → dams. “Small” is already there, and the noun is plural.
explanation.kk: «using small dams made of peat or wood» → dams. «Small» сөйлемде тұр, сан — көпше.
explanation.ru: «using small dams made of peat or wood» → dams. «Small» уже в предложении, число — множественное.

items.quote: the water table rose by 30 centimetres within two years
items.prompt: On one restored site, the water table rose by 5 ____ in two years.

explanation.en: “rose by 30 centimetres within two years” → 30 centimetres (“30 cm” is also accepted). “Two years” is already in the sentence.
explanation.kk: «rose by 30 centimetres within two years» → 30 centimetres (30 cm да есептеледі). «Two years» сөйлемде тұр.
explanation.ru: «rose by 30 centimetres within two years» → 30 centimetres (30 cm тоже засчитывается). «Two years» уже стоит в предложении.
